faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How much alcohol do I need for my event?
faq.a1: The amount of alcohol depends on the number of guests, the event's duration, the type of gathering, and whether you're planning wine, spirits, sparkling, cocktails or non-alcoholic drinks. The calculator produces an approximate result that we can then tailor individually.
faq.a2: No. The calculator's result is approximate and helps define an initial requirement. The final recommendation can be adjusted by a Fine Spirits consultant to match the menu, budget, event style and guests' preferences.
faq.a3: Yes, the consultation and preparing an initial proposal are free. After you submit the form, we'll contact you to discuss the details.
faq.q4: What events do you prepare alcohol for?
faq.a4: We prepare selections for weddings, birthdays, private parties, garden parties, dinners, banquets, corporate events and business meetings.
faq.q5: Can I choose only selected alcohol categories?
faq.a5: Yes. You can select only the categories that interest you — for example wine, spirits, sparkling, non-alcoholic drinks or a mixed set.
faq.q6: Can you prepare an offer for several budgets?
faq.a6: Yes. We can prepare several options: classic, premium or mixed. This makes it easier to match the choice to the event's character and your planned budget.
faq.q7: Do you deliver the order to the event venue?
faq.a7: Yes, we deliver orders throughout Poland. Delivery details depend on the location, date and size of the order.
